headlines.description: Shayne Graham's 32-yard field goal with 2:21 left overtime lifted the Houston Texans to a 34-31 win over Detroit on Thursday after the Lions' coach made a costly mistake in regulation.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans prevail in OT after Schwartz's miscue

headlines.description: Robert Griffin III threw for 311 yards and four touchdowns, helping the Washington Redskins beat the Dallas Cowboys 38-31 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: RG3 tosses 4 TDs, lifts Redskins past Cowboys

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw three touchdown passes and ran for a score as the New England Patriots embarrassed the New York Jets with a 35-point second quarter in a 49-19 victory Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats embarrass Jets; Belichick nets 200th win

headlines.description: The Bears beat the Vikings 28-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutler sharp in return as Bears bounce Vikings

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw three touchdown passes and the Cincinnati Bengals showed their former franchise quarterback that they've moved on without him, beating Carson Palmer and the Oakland Raiders 34-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton outduels Palmer, tosses 3 TDs in rout

headlines.description: Chris Rainey's fumble with 2:25 left -- Pittsburgh's seventh turnover -- was recovered by Cleveland's Phil Taylor and the Browns handed their hated rivals a potentially devastating loss, 20-14 over the stumbling Steelers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns force 8 turnovers in win over Steelers

headlines.description: T.Y. Hilton scored on a 75-yard punt return and caught an 8-yard TD pass Sunday, leading the Colts to a 20-13 victory over Buffalo.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hilton's two touchdowns spark Colts past Bills

events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw for 285 yards and two touchdowns, and the Denver Broncos rallied to beat the woeful Kansas City Chiefs 17-9 on Sunday for their sixth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning rallies Broncos past woeful Chiefs

headlines.description: Dan Carpenter kicked a 43-yard field goal on the final play Sunday, and the Miami Dolphins scored 17 points in the last 8:08 to rally past the Seattle Seahawks 24-21.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins snap skid on Carpenter's field goal

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw for 353 yards and overcame two big turnovers by leading another late touchdown drive to give the Atlanta Falcons a 24-23 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan leads Falcons' late comeback vs. Bucs

headlines.description: Chad Henne threw two touchdown passes, sparking the NFL's worst offense for the second consecutive week, and the Jacksonville Jaguars beat the Tennessee Titans 24-19 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henne helps Jags top Titans, snap 7-game skid

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Justin Tucker kicked a 38-yard field with 1:07 left in overtime to complete a stunning comeback for the Ravens, who beat the staggering Chargers 16-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late OT field goal pushes Ravens past Chargers

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Ahmad Brooks and Donte Whitner returned interceptions for touchdowns, the 49ers sacked Drew Brees five times, and San Francisco ended the New Orleans Saints' three-game winning streak, 31-21 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers use Kaepernick, defense to down Saints

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: The Rams dominated the second half to hand the Cardinals their seventh loss in a row, 31-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jenkins returns 2 picks for TDs in Rams' win

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New York Giants

headlines.description: The Giants beat the Packers 38-10 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eli, Giants end slide by sacking Rodgers, Pack

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for two touchdowns and ran for two more to lead the Carolina Panthers to a 30-22 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Monday night in a matchup of teams with the worst records in the NFC.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton good for 4 TDs as Panthers stop Eagles
